cues.text: Hand-drawn. A sign at the school gate: Graduation Ceremony.
Mitsuru walks under the cherry trees.
In a karaoke room, Yukari sings into a microphone.
Junpei lounges on a couch, phone to his ear, laughing.
The hero sits apart, eyes on a glowing screen.
The three of them in the room. The colour drains to grey.
